description: This file contains functions and classes for unification and reification of Python objects, including handling of __slots__ and __dict__ attributes, and integration with a dispatch system. It defines functions for registering unifiable classes, reifying objects with substitutions, and unifying objects and slices.

methods.name: unifiable
methods.description: Registers unify and reify operations on a class, enabling unification and reification based on class attributes.

methods.name: reify_object
methods.description: Reifies a Python object with a given substitution, handling objects with __slots__ and __dict__.

methods.name: _reify_object_dict
methods.description: Reifies an object's __dict__ with a substitution.

methods.name: _reify_object_slots
methods.description: Reifies an object's __slots__ attributes with a substitution.

methods.name: _reify
methods.description: Reifies a slice object with a substitution.

methods.name: unify_object
methods.description: Unifies two Python objects, including their type and attributes.
